rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account dated 4 June 2010 says the Hatoyama cabinet resigned en masse that day: the cabinet meeting collected the resignations and decided the resignation, the Prime Minister's statement was issued, and 鳩山総理 left the Prime Minister's Office seen off by staff.
